children: Volato entered into a Sixth Amendment to its Aircraft Management Services Agreement with flyExclusive, extending the term through 5:00 p.m. ET on December 31, 2026. flyExclusive remains the exclusive provider of aircraft management services to Volato and will continue to use commercially reasonable efforts to include designated aircraft in Volato's Vaunt empty-leg platform at no cost. The amendment does not change previously granted asset option rights. Earlier in 2026, Volato sold $1.3 million of unused IP to flyExclusive under the Agreement; $0.7 million of assets remain available for sale.
